data.name: Nisiah
data.gender_notes: Nisiah is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'nisos' meaning island or peninsula, and 'ia' meaning God. Nisiah translates to 'Given by God' or 'God's Gift'. The name Nisiah carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nisiah usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's divine intervention in one's life.
data.etymology: Nisiah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Given by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nisiah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: ניסיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם תאופורי הנושא פרטי קדושה, שמקורו בעברית קדושה וקשור למושג 'אלוהים' (אל). השם נושא סמכות וגאולה, והוא קשור לכוח ולמידה. על-פי האגדה, השם 'ניסיה' הוא צורה תאופורית של השם 'אלק' (אל), שפירושו 'אלוהים'.

in_greek.name: Νισία
in_greek.meaning: όνομα θρησκευτικό που συνδέεται με την εκκλησία
in_greek.long_meaning: όνομα θρησκευτικό που συνδέεται με την εκκλησία και την κυριαρχία. Ο λόγος για την προέλευση του ονόματος Νισία, συνδέεται με την αρχαία ελληνική λέξη 'νίκη' που σημαίνει 'νίκη' ή 'τριαντάφυλλο'. Στη χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Νισία συνδέεται με την ιδέα της νίκης και της θριαμβευτικής δύναμης του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Nisiah
in_latin.meaning: nomen religiosum quod Christianitate originem ducit
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen religiosum quod Christianitate originem ducit et significat potestatem et liberationem. Verbum Nisiah est forma theophorica quae a verbo 'Deus' oriundum est, quod significat 'Deus'. Secundum traditionem Christianam, nomen Nisiah significat potestatem et liberationem per Deum.

in_english.name: Nisiah
in_english.meaning: a name of religious significance originating from Christianity
in_english.long_meaning: a name of religious significance originating from Christianity, meaning power and deliverance. The name Nisiah is a theophoric name derived from the word 'God', meaning 'God'. According to Christian tradition, the name Nisiah signifies power and deliverance through God, symbolizing the victory and triumphant power of God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nisiah carries a rich cultural heritage, reminding us of the ancient Greek influence on Christian names. Nisiah is a unique and meaningful name that is a testament to the breadth and diversity of Christian origins and traditions. It also connects us to the concept of being a 'Light on an Island,' representing the idea of being a beacon of hope and faith in a challenging, often tumultuous world.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Nisiah is deeply rooted in the idea of being a gift from God. It is a reminder of the divine plan underlying all of our lives, and the ultimate source of our purpose and identity. For those named Nisiah, it serves as a daily reminder of the grace and love of God, and the responsibility to live a life reflecting the best of His divine attributes. Additionally, as a 'Gift from God,' it suggests a call to use our unique abilities and talents to make the world a better place, and to bring joy, hope, and inspiration to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nisiah, meaning "God is my refuge," emphasizes the faith and trust in God's protection during life's trials and challenges. It symbolizes the strong belief that God is always present, offering shelter and safety.

historical_references.reference: In ancient Christian tradition, Nisiah is mentioned as a variant of the name Nisias, associated with the apostle Paul.
